label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (iter-1, cold, compile-only ablation)
summary: All 51 LRE requirements implemented across 15 Java files (package lre). 4 design choices, 3 invented defaults, 1 ambiguous requirement flagged for review.

issues.title: Event record names are lowercase to match requirement event names
issues.raw: InputEvent/OutputEvent variant records are named reqVel, reqHdng, reqOCM, reqMOM, reqHCM, endTask, advVel, advHdng (lowercase initial), matching LRE-DM6/LRE-DM7 verbatim so extracted RoboChart event channels carry the spec names.
issues.fix_directive: If idiomatic Java naming (ReqVel, AdvVel) is preferred over spec-verbatim channel names, rename the records; the extracted channel names will then differ from the requirement names.

issues.title: HCM entry velocity: 0 m/s (LRE-FR3) vs 0.1 m/s (system description)
issues.raw: system_description.txt describes HCM as 'Reduced speed (0.1 m/s)' but LRE-FR3 says 'On entering HCM, the LRE advises a velocity of 0 m/s'. Implemented advVel(0.0) per requirement_all.json as the canonical source.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm whether HCM entry should advise 0 or 0.1 m/s; change the advVel argument at the four HCM-entry sites in step() if 0.1 is intended.

issues.title: CAM has no entry action
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 says CAM 'performs evasive manoeuvres' but specifies no concrete actuator command. No entry action is emitted on entering CAM; the only CAM output is advVel(0) on the Beh18 exit transition.
issues.fix_directive: If an evasive command (e.g. an advised velocity or heading) is expected on CAM entry, specify it and it will be added inline at the two CAM-entry sites.

issues.title: cda is evaluated at max(tcpa, 0); tcpa reported raw
issues.raw: Sensor.cpaDist clamps the evaluation time to now when the closest point of approach lies in the past, so a receding obstacle yields the current (growing) distance and CAM can exit via LRE-Beh18. Sensor.cpaTime returns the raw (possibly negative) tcpa consumed by the Beh8/Beh14 guards.
issues.fix_directive: If cda should instead be the unclamped mathematical CPA distance, remove the atTime clamp in Sensor.cpaDist (note: CAM could then fail to exit while a past-CPA obstacle recedes).

issues.title: Transition priority order within MOM/HCM mode blocks
issues.raw: Requirements do not specify relative priority among a mode's transitions. Chosen order in MOM: reqOCM > endTask > reqHCM > inOpez > CAM-entry (cda/tcpa) > HCM-entries (Beh9 > Beh10 > Beh11). In HCM: reqOCM > inOpez > CAM-entry > MOM-return.
issues.fix_directive: If a different priority is intended (e.g. collision avoidance above operator requests), reorder the inner else-if branches.

issues.title: CheckOPEZ and CalcCPA re-derive the closest-obstacle index from the Sensor
issues.raw: LRE-OP2/LRE-OP5 say these operations use the index computed by CalcCStc/CalcCDyn. Operation compute() bodies are restricted to sensor calls and own fields (codegen rules), so they call sensor.closestStaticIndex()/closestDynamicIndex() directly — the same value CalcCStc/CalcCDyn store in the same step.
issues.fix_directive: If cross-operation data flow must be literal, pass the CalcCStc/CalcCDyn instances into CheckOPEZ/CalcCPA constructors and read their getters in compute().

issues.title: cstc/cdyn are plain int (RoboChart int), not nat
issues.raw: LRE-Var5/LRE-Var6 call them natural-number variables, but -1 is a documented legal value (no obstacle), so the fields use the default int mapping rather than @RoboChartType("nat").
issues.fix_directive: If the formal model must type them nat, the -1 sentinel must be removed from the requirement (e.g. via an option type), since nat cannot hold -1.

issues.title: Safe large distance default is 1.0e9 metres
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires distance functions to return 'a safe large distance' when no obstacle exists but gives no value. SAFE_LARGE_DISTANCE = 1.0e9 m chosen (private to Sensor).
issues.fix_directive: Specify the intended sentinel distance if 1.0e9 is unsuitable.

issues.title: Literal 1.0 thresholds in Beh4/Beh9/Beh11 guards
issues.raw: LRE-Beh4 ('greater than 1', 'less than or equal to 1') and the hvel/vvel >= 1 m/s thresholds (Beh9/Beh11) are coded as literal 1.0 because the requirements state the number directly; named LreConstants are used only where a requirement names the threshold (minSafeDist, staticObs*Dist).
issues.fix_directive: If these literals should be named constants in the formal model, add them to LreConstants and reference them in the predicates.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> t2m -> m2m -> m2t -> dafny_gen -> isabelle_gen) and iterate on the visible feedback files.
